_readme: Times/Durations are in SECONDS. Costs are mana. player.mana_regen_rate is percent of max mana regenerated every 6 frames (0.5 = 0.5%). Don't rename the names in the quotes, just change numbers!

compatibility._readme: Overrides only restrict implemented compatibility. Built-in Form modifiers: area and chain accept projectile/beam/strike/rune; pierce accepts projectile/beam. Effect modifiers: area accepts combust/discharge; amplify accepts harm/fire/snap/combust/discharge; extend_time accepts fire/ice/lightning/hex; delay accepts all real Effects. Pull accepts projectile/strike/rune; other real Effects accept all Forms. IDs: AoE = area, Frost = ice.
compatibility._defaults: Omitted settings add no restrictions. Set form_modifier_exclusions to {} and exclusive_form_modifier_groups to [] to restore built-in compatibility. Exclusions affect Form attachments only, so eligible Effect AoE remains allowed. Exclusive groups allow one modifier TYPE per Form; repeated Pierce/Chain stacks remain allowed, Area cannot stack. Restart the game after editing.

modifiers._readme: Optional max_per_form and max_per_effect cap copies of that modifier independently on each Form or Effect group, including repeated Effects after Delay. Omit a field for no additional cap; 0 forbids that attachment; positive integers set the maximum. Compatibility, non-stacking rules and level total glyph limits still apply. Restart after editing.
